The '''Dark Star Hellions''' was the name of a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It ran [[Spice/Legends|spice]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] weapons, and served as muscle for various underworld factions.

The [[Questal/Legends|Questal]] chapter was known as the [[Nebula Masters]].
